duration: Seasonal summer jobs. Season dates are not stated on the pages read.
pay_detail: In the aquatics job fair post (dated Feb 18, 2025): lifeguards $18 an hour, swim instructors $18, concession staff $15. The district job board (read Oct 2026) lists swim instructor at $18 and concessions at $15.
name: Aquatics and Seasonal Park Jobs
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at district pools and The Water Works as a lifeguard, swim instructor or concession worker. Paid lifeguard CPR and AED training is provided. Other seasonal park and recreation jobs are on the district job board.
who_can_apply: Minimum ages are not stated on the pages read. Check each job posting.
deadline_text: An aquatics job fair post dated February 18, 2025 listed fairs on Wednesday, March 19; Wednesday, April 16; and Thursday, May 8 at the Community Recreation Center, 505 N. Springinsguth Road. The fair dates have no year printed. 2027 dates are not posted yet. The district job board has live postings.
how_to_apply: Go to a job fair. Or apply on the district's online job board (BambooHR). Questions: Alex Khodan, Supervisor of Aquatics, alkhodan@parkfun.com.
notes: Pay figures for lifeguards are from the 2025 post, so check the current rate. In Illinois, workers under 16 need a work permit (employment certificate) before they start. This comes from the Evanston Township High School work permit page.
